# The equation (<key>_terms, or <group or key>_shared for buildings sharing a cap) is named unlabelled, so the

# max-level tooltip lists its rows; a shared cap subtracts the other members' levels. Clamp and member rows show

# only where they change the value.

}

	value = development

pp_wb_cap_field_management = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_field_management_shared
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_cap_field_management_shared > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_field_management_convertible > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_FIELD_MANAGEMENT_CONVERTIBLE"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_management_building_level_wb_shared_field_managemen
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_field_management_improved > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_FIELD_MANAGEMENT_IMPROVED"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_management_building_level_wb_shared_field_managemen_2
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_jiangnan_hill_terraces > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_JIANGNAN_HILL_TERRACES"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_management_building_level_wb_shared_jiangnan_hill_t
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_field_management > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_QUEUED"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_management_building_level_wb_queued
	} }
	if = { limit = { OR = { pp_wb_standing_field_management_convertible > 0 pp_wb_standing_field_management_improved > 0 pp_wb_standing_jiangnan_hill_terraces > 0 pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_field_management > 0 } pp_wb_cap_field_management_open < 0 } min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 } }
}

pp_wb_cap_field_management_open = {
	value = pp_wb_cap_field_management_shared
	max = 15
	subtract = pp_wb_standing_field_management_convertible
	subtract = pp_wb_standing_field_management_improved
	subtract = pp_wb_standing_jiangnan_hill_terraces
	subtract = pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_field_management
}

pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_field_management = {
	value = 0
	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 1 OR = { building_type = building_type:field_management_convertible building_type = building_type:field_management_improved building_type = building_type:jiangnan_hill_terraces } }
		add = 1 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 1 }
	}
}

		add = 1 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 1 }
	}
}

pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_BASE"
		value = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_continental_monsoon }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_CONTINENTAL_MONSOON"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = ha1300_climate_highland_monsoon }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_HIGHLAND_MONSOON"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = mediterranean }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_MEDITERRANEAN"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { climate = subtropical }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_CLIMATE_SUBTROPICAL"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { topography = atoll }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_ATOLL"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_deltas }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_DELTAS"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = mountain_wasteland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_MOUNTAIN_WASTELAND"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { vegetation = farmland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_FARMLAND"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_marsh }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_MARSH"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_swamp }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SWAMP"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_DEVELOPMENT"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared_building_level_wb_development
	}
}

# Tooltip helpers of pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared (cap_tooltips.py): each is one row of the cap, read through this.
pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared_building_level_wb_development = {
	value = development
	multiply = 0.02
}

pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared
	if = { limit = { development > 500 pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_qanats > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_QANATS"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems_building_level_wb_shared_qanats
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_bund > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_BUND"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems_building_level_wb_shared_bund
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_field_drainage > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_FIELD_DRAINAGE"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems_building_level_wb_shared_field_drainage
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_polders > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_POLDERS"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems_building_level_wb_shared_polders
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_khmer_baray > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems_building_level_wb_shared_khmer_baray
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_incamisana > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_INCAMISANA"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems_building_level_wb_shared_incamisana
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_QUEUED"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems_building_level_wb_queued
	} }
	if = { limit = { OR = { pp_wb_standing_qanats > 0 pp_wb_standing_bund > 0 pp_wb_standing_field_drainage > 0 pp_wb_standing_polders > 0 pp_wb_standing_khmer_baray > 0 pp_wb_standing_incamisana > 0 pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems > 0 } pp_wb_cap_irrigation_systems_open < 0 } min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 } }
}

	value = 0
	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 1 OR = { building_type = building_type:qanats building_type = building_type:bund building_type = building_type:field_drainage building_type = building_type:polders building_type = building_type:khmer_baray building_type = building_type:incamisana } }
		add = 1 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 1 }
	}
}

pp_wb_cap_bund_open = {
	value = pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared
	max = 15
	subtract = pp_wb_standing_irrigation_systems
	subtract = pp_wb_standing_qanats
	subtract = pp_wb_standing_field_drainage
	subtract = pp_wb_standing_polders

	subtract = pp_wb_standing_incamisana

}

pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_bund = {
	value = 0
	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 1 OR = { building_type = building_type:irrigation_systems building_type = building_type:qanats building_type = building_type:field_drainage building_type = building_type:polders building_type = building_type:khmer_baray building_type = building_type:incamisana } }
		add = 1 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 1 }
	}
}

pp_wb_cap_field_drainage = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared
	if = { limit = { development > 500 pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_irrigation_systems > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_drainage_building_level_wb_shared_irrigation_syst
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_qanats > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_QANATS"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_drainage_building_level_wb_shared_qanats
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_bund > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_BUND"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_drainage_building_level_wb_shared_bund
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_polders > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_POLDERS"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_drainage_building_level_wb_shared_polders
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_khmer_baray > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_drainage_building_level_wb_shared_khmer_baray
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_incamisana > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_INCAMISANA"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_drainage_building_level_wb_shared_incamisana
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_field_drainage > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_QUEUED"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_field_drainage_building_level_wb_queued
	} }
	if = { limit = { OR = { pp_wb_standing_irrigation_systems > 0 pp_wb_standing_qanats > 0 pp_wb_standing_bund > 0 pp_wb_standing_polders > 0 pp_wb_standing_khmer_baray > 0 pp_wb_standing_incamisana > 0 pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_field_drainage > 0 } pp_wb_cap_field_drainage_open < 0 } min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 } }
}

	add = {

	}

			value = 3
		}
	}

		}

		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_FLOODPLAINS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = hills }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_HILLS"
			value = -3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = mountain_wasteland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_MOUNTAIN_WASTELAND"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = mountains }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_MOUNTAINS"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = plateau }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_PLATEAU"
			value = -2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_rolling }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_ROLLING"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = ha1300_topo_valleys }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_VALLEYS"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = wetlands }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_TOPOGRAPHY_WETLANDS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_coniferous_forest }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_CONIFEROUS_FOREST"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = desert }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_DESERT"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_dry_forest }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_DRY_FOREST"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = farmland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_FARMLAND"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = jungle }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_JUNGLE"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_marsh }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_MARSH"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_mixed_forest }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_MIXED_FOREST"
			value = 2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_savanna }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SAVANNA"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_scrubland }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SCRUBLAND"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = sparse }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SPARSE"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_swamp }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_SWAMP"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_thicket }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_THICKET"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_tundra }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_TUNDRA"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { vegetation = woods }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_VEGETATION_WOODS"
			value = 4
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_high }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_HIGH"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_low }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_LOW"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_very_high }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_VERY_HIGH"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_fertility_very_low }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_FERTILITY_VERY_LOW"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_DEVELOPMENT"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared_building_level_wb_development
	}
}

# Tooltip helpers of pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared (cap_tooltips.py): each is one row of the cap, read through this.
pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared_building_level_wb_development = {
	value = development
	multiply = 0.05
}

pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_jiangnan_canal_network > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_JIANGNAN_CANAL_NETWORK"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_building_level_wb_shared_jiangnan_canal_
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_QUEUED"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_building_level_wb_queued
	} }
	if = { limit = { OR = { pp_wb_standing_jiangnan_canal_network > 0 pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control > 0 } pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_open < 0 } min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 } }
}

# Tooltip helpers of pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control (cap_tooltips.py): each is one row of the cap, read through this.
pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_building_level_wb_shared_jiangnan_canal_ = {
	value = pp_wb_standing_jiangnan_canal_network
}

pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_building_level_wb_queued = {
	value = pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control
}

pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_open = {
	value = pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared
	max = 15
	subtract = pp_wb_standing_jiangnan_canal_network
	subtract = pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control
}

pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control = {
	value = 0
	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 1 OR = { building_type = building_type:jiangnan_canal_network } }
		add = 1 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 1 }
	}
}

pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network = {
	add = pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared > 15 } max = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MAXIMUM" value = 15 } }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_standing_paddy_water_control > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_SHARED_PADDY_WATER_CONTROL"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network_building_level_wb_shared_paddy_water_con
	} }
	if = { limit = { pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network > 0 } subtract = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_QUEUED"
		value = this.pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network_building_level_wb_queued
	} }
	if = { limit = { OR = { pp_wb_standing_paddy_water_control > 0 pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network > 0 } pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network_open < 0 } min = { desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_WB_MINIMUM" value = 0 } }
}

# Tooltip helpers of pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network (cap_tooltips.py): each is one row of the cap, read through this.
pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network_building_level_wb_shared_paddy_water_con = {
	value = pp_wb_standing_paddy_water_control
}

pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network_building_level_wb_queued = {
	value = pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network
}

pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network_open = {
	value = pp_wb_cap_paddy_water_control_shared
	max = 15
	subtract = pp_wb_standing_paddy_water_control
	subtract = pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network
}

pp_wb_queued_pp_wb_cap_jiangnan_canal_network = {
	value = 0
	every_buildings_in_location = {
		limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 1 OR = { building_type = building_type:paddy_water_control } }
		add = 1 if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 2 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 3 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 4 } add = 1 } if = { limit = { building_levels_under_construction >= 5 } add = 1 }
	}
}
